figures.caption: Figure 2: ColPali corpus scaling on A100-40GB (Lq=Ld=1024). Naive einsum in pure FP16 and in matched FP32 (FP32 accumulation) both hit OOM cliffs as the corpus grows (matched FP32 at B≈7K, FP16 at B≈20K); FLASH-MAXSIM keeps scaling to B≈175K because its peak memory tracks only the document embeddings, so the Lq × Ld similarity matrix never exists. Left: latency. Right: peak memory.
